headline.purpose: Section heads in the Info tab.

title.purpose: Dialog titles, uppercase; popup titles at 14px.

body.purpose: Running text; hints at 12.5px in collar grey.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked lettering for field labels, table heads, sub-heads; sheet title line at 800 / 0.14em.

button.purpose: Uppercase button, tab and tool lettering; 11.5px small.

figure-display.purpose: The active central meridian, in contour brown.

figure-small.purpose: Tables, meta lines, DMS, popups, cursor readout.

collar.purpose: Neatline tick lettering and scale-bar figures; corner lettering at 9px.

shadows.name: control-lift

shadows.purpose: Knock-out halo on map symbols; point labels use a stacked paper text-shadow.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid ink action; one per task, hovers to contour brown.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4.5"/><path d="M12 3v4M12 17v4M3 12h4M17 12h4"/></svg>Place on map</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #111111); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper, #fafaf7); color: var(--ink, #111111); font: 700 12.5px 'Overpass', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, color .15s; } .ds-btn svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: square; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink, #111111); color: var(--paper, #fafaf7); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--brown, #a0522d); border-color: var(--brown, #a0522d); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1f6fb2); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Paper button outlined in ink; companion actions and exports.
components.css: .ds-btn2 { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #111111); border-radius: 0; background: var(--paper, #fafaf7); color: var(--ink, #111111); font: 700 12.5px 'Overpass', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn2 svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: square; } .ds-btn2:hover { background: var(--paper-2, #f0eee6); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1f6fb2); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn2:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Borderless small action for toolbars; gains an ink border on hover.
components.css: .ds-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 32px; padding: 5px 9px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #3a3935); font: 700 11.5px 'Overpass', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, color .15s; } .ds-ghost svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: square; } .ds-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #111111); background: var(--paper, #fafaf7); color: var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1f6fb2); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Coordinate Field
components.description: Field-white well, ink outline, mono figures, blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-fld { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 170px; } .ds-fld span { font: 700 11px 'Overpass', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3, #66655e); } .ds-input { border: 1px solid var(--ink, #111111); border-radius: 0; background: var(--white, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #111111); padding: 7px 9px; font: 15px 'Overpass Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; caret-color: var(--brown, #a0522d); outline: none; transition: box-shadow .15s; } .ds-input:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--blue, #1f6fb2); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Ink-boxed choice; the active segment is an ink fill.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-seg button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #111111); padding: 6px 12px; font: 700 12.5px 'Overpass', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-seg button:hover { background: var(--paper-2, #f0eee6); } .ds-seg button.on { background: var(--ink, #111111); color: var(--paper, #fafaf7); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1f6fb2); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Margin Tabs
components.description: Full-width tabs between a 2px and a 1px ink rule; active carries a 3px ink underline.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; width: 380px; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #111111); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, #111111); background: var(--paper, #fafaf7); } .ds-tabs button { flex: 1; border: 0; background: none; padding: 11px 0 10px; font: 700 12px 'Overpass', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3, #66655e); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tabs button + button { border-left: 1px solid var(--hair, #cfccc1); } .ds-tabs button:hover { color: var(--ink, #111111); background: var(--paper-2, #f0eee6); } .ds-tabs button.on { color: var(--ink, #111111); box-shadow: inset 0 -3px var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1f6fb2); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Result Group
components.description: Margin-column result: 2px ink rule, brown head, label, dotted leader, mono figure. Empty state: sentence-case collar-grey hint led by a brown caps tag (VÍ DỤ / Example) over a muted worked example.
components.css: .ds-res { width: 336px; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #111111); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink, #111111); padding: 6px 0 7px; background: var(--paper, #fafaf7); color: var(--ink, #111111); } .ds-res-head { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 3px; } .ds-res-head b { font: 800 11.5px 'Overpass', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--brown, #a0522d); } .ds-res-head em { font: 11.5px 'Overpass Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-style: normal; color: var(--ink-3, #66655e); } .ds-res-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; } .ds-res-row i { font: 700 11px 'Overpass', system-ui, sans-serif; font-style: normal; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-3, #66655e); } .ds-res-row::after { content: ''; order: 1; flex: 1; border-bottom: 1px dotted var(--ink-3, #66655e); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-res-row code { order: 2; font: 15.5px 'Overpass Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Map Control Group
components.description: Square paper buttons floating inside the neatline; toggled state fills with ink.
components.css: .ds-ctrl { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--paper, #fafaf7); border: 1px solid var(--ink, #111111); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(17, 17, 17, .18); } .ds-ctrl button { width: 36px; height: 36px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #111111); cursor: pointer; } .ds-ctrl button + button { border-top: 1px solid var(--hair, #cfccc1); } .ds-ctrl button:hover { background: var(--paper-2, #f0eee6); } .ds-ctrl button.on { background: var(--ink, #111111); color: var(--paper, #fafaf7); } .ds-ctrl button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1f6fb2); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-ctrl svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: square; stroke-linejoin: miter; }

components.name: Graduated Neatline
components.description: Signature collar (static sample): inner neatline, heavy outer frame, km ticks lettered in mono, brown unit, red cursor ticks, alternating scale bar.
components.html: <svg class="ds-collar" viewBox="0 0 300 200"><rect x="40" y="30" width="220" height="120" fill="#dcd8cc"/><rect x="39.5" y="29.5" width="221" height="121" class="nl-in"/><rect x="22" y="12" width="256" height="156" class="nl-out"/><line x1="80" y1="30" x2="80" y2="23" class="tk"/><line x1="150" y1="30" x2="150" y2="23" class="tk"/><line x1="220" y1="30" x2="220" y2="23" class="tk"/><text x="80" y="21">588</text><text x="150" y="21">589</text><text x="220" y="21">590</text><line x1="40" y1="70" x2="35" y2="70" class="tk"/><line x1="40" y1="120" x2="35" y2="120" class="tk"/><text transform="translate(31.5 70) rotate(-90)">2329</text><text transform="translate(31.5 120) rotate(-90)">2328</text><text x="31" y="21" class="unit" text-anchor="end">km</text><line x1="118" y1="30" x2="118" y2="14" class="cur"/><line x1="40" y1="96" x2="24" y2="96" class="cur"/><rect x="40" y="174" width="15" height="5" class="sb0"/><rect x="55" y="174" width="15" height="5" class="sb1"/><rect x="70" y="174" width="15" height="5" class="sb0"/><rect x="85" y="174" width="15" height="5" class="sb1"/><text x="40" y="192">0</text><text x="100" y="192">500 m</text></svg>
components.css: .ds-collar { width: 300px; height: 200px; background: var(--paper, #fafaf7); } .ds-collar text { font: 10.5px 'Overpass Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; fill: var(--ink, #111111); text-anchor: middle; } .ds-collar .unit { font: 700 9.5px 'Overpass', system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; fill: var(--brown, #a0522d); } .ds-collar .nl-in { fill: none; stroke: #111111; stroke-width: 1; } .ds-collar .nl-out { fill: none; stroke: #111111; stroke-width: 2.5; } .ds-collar .tk { stroke: #111111; stroke-width: 1.2; } .ds-collar .cur { stroke: #c8102e; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-collar .sb0 { fill: #111111; stroke: #111111; } .ds-collar .sb1 { fill: #fafaf7; stroke: #111111; }

components.name: Toast
components.description: Ink bar that rises 12px into place; survey red for errors.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-block; padding: 9px 16px; background: var(--ink, #111111); color: var(--paper, #fafaf7); font: 600 13px 'Overpass', system-ui, sans-serif; border-radius: 0; animation: ds-rise .3s cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1); } .ds-toast.err { background: var(--red, #c8102e); } @keyframes ds-rise { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The live web map is treated as a printed VN-2000 map sheet. A graduated neatline frames it on all four sides, lettered in kilometres of the active VN-2000 zone (or in degrees and minutes when zoomed out), and it re-letters itself on every pan and zoom. The working panel is the sheet's margin column: title block, meridian block, data, legend and copyright, stacked and separated by heavy ink rules the way a sheet's marginalia are. Everything a surveyor reads is a figure; every figure is set in tabular monospace.

The palette is cartographic, not decorative: warm sheet paper and near-black plate ink carry the structure, contour brown is the sheet's own voice (the active meridian, the projection name, section heads), and survey red, hydrography blue and vegetation green are reserved for what lands on the map. The world is light only; a paper sheet in office and field daylight. Density is a surveyor's density: small tracked capitals for labels, compact rows with dotted leaders, no cards and no rounded corners.

The world refuses the category default for map tools: a floating, rounded, translucent card over an unframed web map.
keyCharacteristics: Live graduated neatline around the map: thin inner line, heavy outer frame, ticks lettered in km, red cursor ticks on every edge, alternating-segment scale bar in the bottom band.
Margin column at 380px, divided by 2px ink rules, meeting the sheet with a 4px double rule.
Overpass lettering in tracked small capitals for labels; Overpass Mono tabular figures for every coordinate, meridian, parameter and count.
Square corners everywhere; solid ink fill marks the active, selected or primary state.
Shadows only on objects that float over the map; the paper itself is flat.
On phones the margin column becomes a bottom sheet snapping peek / half / full over a full-screen map.

rules.name: The Sheet Voice Rule
rules.body: Contour brown belongs to the sheet, not the data: meridian, projection name, section heads, active rules. If a brown mark could be mistaken for a feature, it is wrong.

rules.name: The Symbology Rule
rules.body: Red is points, blue is lines (and selection and focus), green is areas, on the map, in the legend and in the feature list icons alike. These hues never decorate.

rules.name: The Ink Fill Rule
rules.body: Active, selected, pressed-on and primary states are solid plate ink with paper text. There is no tinted "selected" colour.

rules.name: The Figures-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Every coordinate, meridian, parameter, length, area and count is Overpass Mono with tabular numerals; numeric table columns are right-aligned. Proportional digits never carry a measured value.

rules.name: The Lettering Rule
rules.body: Uppercase with tracking is for small lettering only (labels, buttons, tabs, sheet title, dialog titles, at 15px and below). Running text and the display title stay in sentence case.

rules.name: The Framed Map Rule
rules.body: The map is never shown unframed on desktop: the neatline, its lettering and the cursor ticks are always drawn around it.

rules.name: The Margin Column Rule
rules.body: The panel is the sheet's margin, attached to the edge and divided by rules; it is never a floating card over the map.

rules.name: The Paper-Flat Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the paper casts a shadow. A shadow means "this floats over the map", and nothing else.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: Corner radius is zero. A round shape is allowed only when it is a map symbol.

dos: Do letter every coordinate, meridian, parameter and count in Overpass Mono with tabular numerals.
Do separate margin-column blocks with 2px ink rules, and meet the sheet with the 4px double rule.
Do keep red for points, blue for lines, selection and focus, green for areas, on the map and in the legend alike.
Do mark active and primary states with a solid ink fill and paper text.
Do keep the graduated neatline, its lettering and the red cursor ticks around the map on desktop.
Do use the house ease (cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)) for motion that moves things, and drop all transitions under reduced motion.
donts: Don't float the panel as a rounded, translucent card over an unframed map.
Don't round corners; the only circle is a map symbol.
Don't use contour brown to symbolise a data feature.
Don't add shadows to anything sitting on the paper; shadow means floating over the map.
Don't set measured values in proportional figures, or let a coordinate value break across lines.
Don't add a dark theme; the world is a paper sheet in daylight.
